item.title: How to Update n8n Self-Hosted: Safe Upgrades for Docker Compose, Docker, and npm (2026)
item.description:
Introduction

Updating self-hosted n8n is where most self-hosting horror stories start: a skipped backup, a jumped migration, a dead credential set. This guide shows the safe update path for all three install methods, Docker Compose, plain Docker, and npm, with the exact commands, the pre-update backup routine, and the rollback procedure from n8n’s own documentation. It is written for anyone already running n8n on their own server, and pairs with our guide to installing n8n on an Ubuntu VPS and our Docker Compose setup walkthrough if you set things up with our tutorials.
